column1: # One row per node-neighborhood query. Context values come from config.yaml
# node_id         the ORIGINAL id in chr22.gfa. Used directly by vg, gbz-base
#                 and gfaidx, all of which preserve the input ID space.
# odgi_ref_locus  "<path name>,<path offset>" identifying the SAME locus on a
#                 reference path. odgi only runs on an -O optimized graph, whose
#                 IDs are compacted to 1..N, so the odgi_node_map rule uses
#                 `odgi position -p <locus> -v` to translate this locus into
#                 odgi's node ID. Path offsets here are path-local, which for
#                 CHM13#0#chr22 (walk starts at 0) equals the absolute offset.
